title: Marangoni rods: the Marangoni coefficient (mar 40 -> 60) is the one screened parameter that shifts the whole per-cycle swim distance and keeps division (median D 1.62 -> 2.10 and 1.11 -> 1.85 rod lengths, share >= 2.5 from 0 to 0.36 and 0.20, splits 85-96% of base, seeds 70-71); a lower bath lengthens swims but cuts divisions to 20-37%
summary: Ran c34's Marangoni world (CARGO=0, 128^2, T=1000) at base, mar 60, gm 0.5, gm 2, zeta 1.0, kr 0.006 and phi_b -0.65 on seed 70, then base, mar 60 and phi_b -0.65 on seed 71, plus mar 80 on both; per-track traits with c00's extract.py. Against the question's criteria, mar 60 passes on both seeds (median D +0.48/+0.74 rod lengths, share >= 2.5 from 0 to 0.36/0.20, persistent splits 24/25 and 23/27); pooled, D 1.98 vs 1.43, Mann-Whitney p=0.0003. mar 80 gives the same gain but splits drop to 67% on seed 71. phi_b -0.65 raises D (+0.38/+1.28) only through long cycles in a sparse, still-growing population (splits 5 and 10 vs 25 and 27). gm 0.5, gm 2 and zeta 1.0 do not move D; kr 0.006 nearly stops division. mar is the axis to make heritable (Q:marangoni-heritable-ladder).

finding.operator: Marangoni stress coefficient (mar) of the active-nematic rods' self-made surfactant ring
finding.control: same-seed base runs (mar 40) on seeds 70 and 71; 6 other single-parameter settings on seed 70
finding.result: median per-cycle D of dividing rods 1.62->2.10 (s70), 1.11->1.85 (s71); share D>=2.5 0->0.36, 0->0.20; persistent splits 25->24, 27->23; pooled diff CI [+0.15,+1.14], p=0.0003; phi_b -0.65: D +0.38/+1.28 but splits 5/25, 10/27
